text:
maya: Quick flag from today's quant bring-up: q4b-int8 shows a concentrated quality drop on very short instruction->creative prompts (~3.8% accuracy hit on our proprietary metric). Noticed missing nouns in outputs.
ricardo: Example? Could be kv-cache misalignment or tokenizer boundary.
maya: Example pair (shortened):
```
prompt: Turn this tech note into a playful haiku: 'GPU batch size tuning is tricky at scale.'
fp16: "Tuning batch size
cloud hums; GPUs dance light
scale learns to breathe"
int8: "Tuning batch sizes
cloud hum, GPUs whisper slow
scale bites the morning"
```
int8 sometimes drops/rewrites core phrase.
sam: That smells like tokenization mismatch. New tokenizer v2 splits apostrophes/punctuation differently. I'll run token-ids diff across fp16 vs int8 for a sample of 250.
anya: I'll start a curation job: pull 1k prompts from `samplebank/transform_short`, filter length <40 tokens, tag creative/instruction. Dedup with fuzzyhash threshold 0.82 and surface edgecases.
jules: I'll contribute 100 examples from support logs that hit the instruction->creative pattern. Also will add 50 borderline punctuation cases.
labeling-bot: Batch created: https://labeler.internal/batches/8820 1 labelers assigned, ETA ~16h. Reaction: :hourglass:
ricardo: Eng-runtime please run a token-by-token log-prob alignment for 200 examples between fp16 and int8 to locate divergence index (prefix/mid/tail). If divergence is consistently at token n=3-6 that's likely kv cache offset.
sam: Pushing micro-bench to `eng-ml/benchmarks/q4b_int8_token_align`. Will post results in this thread when done.
anya: Plan for golden refresh: expand `golden/creative_short_v2.json` with 300 curated rewrites (200 from labelers + 100 handcrafted). Once labels back, open PR `docs/evals/golden-refresh-2026-03-int8` and rerun canary.
maya: Also add an "instruction-preservation" binary check to the harness (does output contain main noun/phrase?). BLEU alone misses these cases.
ricardo: Agreed. Add that signal and a per-slice alert for creative_short.
jules: FYI I saw similar but rarer behavior on qx2b-int4 when we switched tokenizers last year. Might be useful to compare diffs.
maya: Timeline: labeling + bench results by EOD tomorrow, decision to revert/pause canary if preservations drops >2.5%.
sam: On it. I'll ping when the bench lands.
labeling-bot: Label batch updates will be posted to thread.
maya: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the curation/quant triage. :thumbsup:
